in_arabic.name: كنزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kunz', which means 'to hide, conceal, or protect'. This name is used in various contexts in the Quran, such as in Surah Al-An'am (6:38), where it is mentioned that God will protect those who believe in Him.

in_urdu.name: کنظہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kunz', which means 'to hide, conceal, or protect'. In Urdu, this name is often translated as 'sachaida' (safe), 'bhar-e-makhf' (ocean of concealment), or 'muhafiz' (protector).

in_hindi.name: कुनज़ा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kunz', which means 'to hide, conceal, or protect'. In Hindi, this name is often translated as 'gupt rahana' (to remain hidden) or 'rakshaa' (protector).

in_pashto.name: كنضه
in_pashto.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kunz', which means 'to hide, conceal, or protect'. In Pashto, this name is often translated as 'dorana' (hidden) or 'afadha' (concealed).
